themesFolderHelp: Drop a subfolder here containing <themeCss>theme.css</themeCss> (+ optional <themeJson> theme.json</themeJson>) to add a custom theme. The picker above updates live.
settingHelp.editor.fontFamily: Pick the editor font. Leave blank to use the built-in default.
settingHelp.editor.updateDebounceMs: How long the editor waits after the last keystroke before pushing text to the compile pipeline.
settingHelp.editor.pasteImagePath: Where pasted images (screenshots, copied images, web/Word images) are saved. Macros: ${fileDir}, ${workspace}, ${fileName}, ${filePath}, ${hash}, ${ext}, ${timestamp}, ${index}.
settingHelp.editor.insertImagePath: Where toolbar-inserted images are copied. Macros: ${fileDir}, ${fileName}, ${workspace}, ${ext}, ${timestamp}.
settingHelp.export.pngPixelPerPt: Raster resolution for PNG export. 2.0 ≈ retina; 1.0 = one pixel per point.
settingHelp.export.revisionWaitMs: How long export waits for a pending compile to finish before giving up.
settingHelp.export.autoOnSave: Re-run the project's configured export ([export] format + outputPath in .typstpro) every time a document is saved. Skips silently when the project has no outputPath configured.
settingHelp.export.pdfPageRanges: Restrict PDF export to specific pages, e.g. "1-3,5" or "4-". Empty exports all pages.
settingHelp.export.pdfStandard: Conformance standard enforced during PDF export (archival/A variants embed color profiles and restrict features).
settingHelp.export.pdfTagged: Keep the accessibility tag tree in exported PDFs. Disabling reduces file size but breaks screen-reader support.
settingHelp.document.defaultTemplate: Initial content of a fresh untitled document.
settingHelp.tabs.maxHidden: Soft-closed (background) documents kept for instant reactivation. Oldest is hard-closed past this limit.
settingHelp.appearance.theme: Custom themes live in <app-data>/themes/. Use 'Open themes folder' below to add one.
settingHelp.appearance.language: Choose the UI language. Auto follows your system locale.
settingHelp.action.clearRecentWorkspaces: Remove the list of recently-opened workspace folders.
settingHelp.action.openDevtools: Open the WebView console (F12) on the main window to inspect rendering and IPC errors.
settingHelp.ai.provider: OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, local Ollama, etc.
settingHelp.ai.baseUrl: Leave empty for provider default (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1).
settingHelp.ai.openaiApi: Only Chat Completions is currently implemented; the Responses API path is tracked as a follow-up.
settingHelp.ai.maxTokens: Anthropic requires this; OpenAI ignores it unless you raise it.
settingHelp.lsp.autoDownload: When no tinymist is found, download it automatically to ~/.typststudio/ and use it as the language server.
settingHelp.lsp.tinymistPath: Custom tinymist binary to spawn. Leave empty to prefer the app-managed download (~/.typststudio/) and then PATH.
settingHelp.lsp.formatterMode: The formatter behind Format Document (Shift+Alt+F). Applied live — no LSP restart needed.
settingHelp.lsp.formatterPrintWidth: Preferred line width for the formatter. 0 uses the formatter's own default.
tinymist.title: Managed install
tinymist.notInstalled: Not installed. Download places tinymist under ~/.typststudio/.
tinymist.verifying: Verifying checksum and testing the binary…
tinymist.unsupported: Automatic download is not available for this platform; install tinymist manually and point the binary setting at it.
